[Verse 1]
Morning light is spilling on the wooden porch floor,
You’re sitting with your coffee by the open screen door.
Watching every rosebud slowly wake to greet the sun,
Smiling at the quiet day that has just begun.

[Chorus]
Happy birthday, Mom, you make the garden grow,
More beautiful than all the sweetest roses in a row.
Hearing how you always sing inside the kitchen light,
Turns our everyday into something pure and bright.

[Verse 2]
Kneeling in the soil with your gentle, patient hands,
Giving care and kindness like nobody understands.
Even while you're busy as the kettle starts to steam,
You hum a little tune that feels just like a peaceful dream.

[Chorus]
Happy birthday, Mom, you make the garden grow,
More beautiful than all the sweetest roses in a row.
Hearing how you always sing inside the kitchen light,
Turns our everyday into something pure and bright.

[Bridge]
Thank you for the shelter that you give with every smile,
For walking right beside me through each passing mile.
May this year bring sunshine to everything you sow,
And keep your tender heart right where the roses grow.

[Chorus]
Happy birthday, Mom, you make the garden grow,
More beautiful than all the sweetest roses in a row.
Hearing how you always sing inside the kitchen light,
Turns our everyday into something pure and bright.
